ns2:course.label: Advanced Cinema Studies Topics
ns2:course.description: (CINE 395) Intensive study of critical and historical issues in cinema and related screen media; topics vary and typically include national and ethnic cinemas, directors, genres, historical movements, and thematic studies. 3 undergraduate or 4 graduate hours. May be repeated in the same or separate semesters as topics vary to a maximum of 6 undergraduate hours or 8 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Two college-level Cinema Studies courses, or consent of instructor.
